note: Read-only pins of the default-branch HEADs observed for this study. No file in either source repository was modified. Sector ranks are not recomputed from these commits; they come from data/sector_snapshots.csv, whose market_date and run_created_at are the observation times.

gupiao.use: Formal-push artifacts were already ingested into data/signal_history.csv. This study reads that ledger and the source run created_at. It does not rerun DXDX.

strong_pullback_screener.published_ranks: Top 3 only. The tracker froze those three themes per market_date in data/sector_snapshots.csv.
strong_pullback_screener.use: Exact string match of a frozen industry or curated theme against that day's published top 3. Ranks beyond 3 are not invented.
